r=Robot(); o=r.get_obs(); n=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']); cur=n[7:14].astype(float); q=cur[3:]
# Move above practice, settle.
g=np.array([-.1,-.1856,.12,*q]); N=max(2,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(g[:3]-cur[:3])/.007)))
P=list(np.linspace(cur,g,N+1)[1:]); P += [g.copy()]*10
# Approach the left-to-right practice line at shallow pressure.
start=np.array([-.1,-.2056,.12,*q]); N=max(2,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(start[:3]-P[-1][:3])/.007)))
P += list(np.linspace(P[-1],start,N+1)[1:])
for z in np.arange(.115,.0189,-.005): P.append(np.array([-.1,-.2056,float(z),*q]))
P += [np.array([-.1,-.2056,.019,*q])]*3
end=np.array([-.1,-.1656,.019,*q]); N=max(4,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3]-P[-1][:3])/.005)))
P += list(np.linspace(P[-1],end,N+1)[1:])
# lift straight, then clear over the practice sheet
for z in np.arange(.024,.121,.006): P.append(np.array([-.1,-.1656,float(z),*q]))
res=r.submit('ee_pose',np.asarray(P),dt=.05,video='mp4',note='practice line at shallow pressure')
res.save('/app/output/practice_line')
print('rows',len(P),'failures',sum(x.get('ik_failures',0) for x in res.meta.get('plan',[])),'pose',res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],'left',res.meta['time_left_s'])
